# Lead Lab design decisions
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

The current product direction is a Laravel 13 modular monolith with an Inertia React and TypeScript interface. It implements Option B: a private, self-hosted, Skool-inspired web application. The scope baseline, not the historical WordPress decision, is the current product authority. `application/source/composer.json:10-17`, `application/source/package.json:29-31`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:4-14`

| Decision | Rationale and status | Enforced at |
|---|---|---|
| Use one Laravel modular monolith with an Inertia React interface. | The architecture convention selects a Laravel modular monolith when the supported environment permits it and avoids unnecessary microservices. Current source declares Laravel and Inertia dependencies. `workspace/references/architecture-conventions.md:8-22`, `application/source/composer.json:10-17` | `application/source/bootstrap/app.php:12-37`, `application/source/package.json:29-31` |
| Require account approval before portal access. | The approved scope requires self-registration, pending access, approval, revocation, and restoration. `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:29-32`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:58-60` | `application/source/app/Actions/Fortify/CreateNewUser.php:25-60`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminMemberController.php:39-79` |
| Keep Learning Resources private and serve them through an authenticated download handler. | The scope requires authenticated resource access and server-side access controls. `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:39-40`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:56-60` | `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/LearningResourceController.php:12-27` |
| Treat a Learning Session as publishable and archivable content. | Sessions are the core content unit and have a defined draft, published, archived lifecycle. `CONCEPTS.md:5-10` | `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminLearningSessionController.php:98-109`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminLearningSessionController.php:154-195` |
| Provide event-level reminders at three offsets, resolved against eligible users at send time. | RQ-14 requires 3-day, 1-day, and 15-minute reminders, UTC scheduling, recipient filtering, and duplicate prevention. `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:63`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:99-100` | `application/source/app/Models/CalendarEvent.php:37-95`, `application/source/app/Services/CalendarEventReminderService.php:15-98` |
| Keep email verification mandatory outside the documented local-development exception. | The approved baseline makes verification a target-state requirement; the local bypass is explicitly not staging or production evidence. `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:90-100`, `application/environment/local-development.md:47-57` | `application/source/app/Models/User.php:71-78`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminMemberController.php:50-58` |
| Record important administration actions. | Administrative activity logging is a stated operations requirement. `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:41-44` | `application/source/app/Models/ActivityLog.php:15-28`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminCalendarEventController.php:24-29` |

## Open decisions and boundaries

Video URL-sharing protection and Microsoft 365 SSO remain open decisions. They are not documented here as implemented guarantees. `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:66-68`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:86`

Production mail, queue, scheduler, backups, monitoring, and restore evidence remain launch requirements. The application code implements the reminder path, but does not prove those operating controls. `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:102-123`, `application/ops/calendar-event-reminders.md:6-13`
